cands.name: Rob Long
cands.bio: Democrat incumbent. Won the Dec 2025 special election by 28 points after Rep. Joe Casello's death; first-term member from Delray Beach.

record.text: Carried HB 851 requiring autism-specific training for teachers (passed unanimously) and backed firefighter benefit and PFAS measures in the 2026 session.

money_notes.text: Reported $110,000 raised in the special election with backing from Florida Chamber and AIF.

cands.name: Ionel Roiban
cands.bio: Republican, first-time candidate. Software and AI engineer and consultant; president of the National Committee of Romanian-American Republicans. Born in Romania, came to the U.S. and settled in Boynton Beach in 2001. His LinkedIn lists a role as an adviser to Romania's prime minister (2020).
cands.local_ties: Boynton Beach resident for 25 years (his campaign site).

record.text: No prior elected office. His site argues property-insurance costs and notes Rob Long voted no on HJR 203 (property tax amendment, 80-30 House vote, Feb 2026); these are his campaign claims.
